title: 第3章 建木道解第4章 因解
lines: 周岐离去了，老头手腕上的"七"似乎亮了一丝，但也仅仅是一丝，柱子下，周岐望了望四周，然后看向远处，一道身影在他刚来的路面上望着他
这是一个身穿黑色龙袍头戴王冠的青年男子，九旒冕冠垂下的玉藻在眼前晃动，却遮不住瞳孔深处游走的暗金龙影
他周身似有万千世界在演变，额头上一个黑色的"九"字，整个人犹如帝中之尊
"从你踏入第七柱我便感知到虚空有波动，你牵动了这里的一瞬虚无"
男子一开口周围空间便有破碎之意，一道道裂纹在空中隐隐作现
周岐看着他，没有动
"你不该来这里"
周岐开口的一句话让男子一愣
"我为何不能来"
"你来了，因果就变了，轨迹会再乱一次"
只见周岐单手一点，手指尖端出现一枚灰色碎片，碎片上的一个"七"字一瞬间变成了漆黑的"九"字
"构世九解虚解"
碎片变成一道漆黑光线瞬间射向龙袍男子，男子眼中龙影动了起来
"对本尊出手就要想好后果"
龙袍男子瞬间身体化为虚无一般，正当他以为光线对他没用，刚要抬手时
只见光束射进龙袍男子额头上的"九"字当中，男子下一刻变成一黑色光团向第九柱飞去
"希望没影响太多"
周岐喃喃自语一句话后望向了天顶，九座天柱之上还有一座宫殿，但是没有人能看得见，这是除了九位尊所有人都不知道的宫殿，
"共尊殿，四代无柯尊主共尊时间最为短暂，妄古纪元崩灭于法字道一宫，现在还是仙字宫的时间纪元，还有机会"
周岐说完在身后第七柱上刻下一段字后消失不见
建木道界，木之天道界，隶属于中枢道庭"仙字道一宫"分支中天道界里排名十三的道界
周岐望着眼前的道界久久没有动作
"没有道解木心的气息，看来提前了一些，没有错过就好"
周岐眉头皱了起来又松开，然后向建木界踏入，道界结界竟没有一丝阻挠
建木道界，一个充满生命的修真界，此界没有争斗，没有宗门，没有统治者，不同于其他界的万千道法，这里所有人都只修木之规则，生命的意境
这里是一望无际的绿色海洋，整片大陆都是浓浓的盎然生机，而正中央只有一棵顶天的巨树
只见树根根系延伸不知多少百万里。主干纹理由流动的星河凝成，树冠上每片叶子都是正在坍缩的微型宇宙。
当靠近树干百丈范围，会看见枝桠间悬挂着历代渡劫失败者的道果结晶——那些半透明的琥珀中，有龙凤在永恒挣扎，有修士在重复兵解。
就在这时，建木面前出现了一道身影，正是周岐
"青祖"
周岐面对建木开口说了二字，便一直盯着不再言语，正当没有回应，他刚要抬手时，一道苍老的声音从建木中传来
"我说小子，刚才才见过，怎么你又来了"周岐闻言神色一动
"这是我第几次来"
"好像第六次了吧"
"果然出问题了，你还记得我问的话吗"
"你每次来都问我这是第几次来，第一次问老祖我的时候也是这句，我都搞不懂你们这些小辈了"
要不是感觉你有点危险，老祖才不会搭理你，建木后半句只能在心中腹诽
周岐望着建木没有再说什么，随即消失不见，正当建木松了一口气时，周岐又出现了
"这是我第几次来"
建木愣了一下，好像没有反应过来
content_en:
Zhou Qi left, and the "seven" on the old man's wrist seemed to light up a little, but it was only a little. Under the pillar, Zhou Qi looked around, and then looked into the distance. A figure looked at him on the road where he had just arrived.
This is a young man wearing a black dragon robe and a crown on his head. The jade algae hanging from the nine-colored crown is swaying in front of his eyes, but it cannot cover the dark golden dragon shadow wandering deep in his pupils.
There seemed to be thousands of worlds evolving around him. There was a black character "Nine" on his forehead, making him look like a king among emperors.
"I have felt fluctuations in the void since you stepped into the seventh pillar. You have affected the nothingness here for a moment."
As soon as the man opened his mouth, the space around him felt broken, and cracks appeared faintly in the air.
Zhou Qi looked at him without moving.
"You shouldn't be here"
What Zhou Qi said shocked the man.
"Why can't I come"
"When you come, the cause and effect will change, and the trajectory will be messed up again."
I saw Zhou Qi point one hand, and a gray fragment appeared on the tip of his finger. The character "seven" on the fragment instantly turned into a dark character "nine".
"Nine solutions to the construction of the world"
The fragments turned into a jet of black light and shot toward the man in dragon robe instantly. The dragon shadow moved in the man's eyes.
"If you take action against me, you have to think about the consequences."
The body of the man in the dragon robe instantly turned into nothingness. Just when he thought that the light was useless to him, he was about to raise his hand.
I saw the beam of light shining into the character "Nine" on the forehead of the man in the dragon robe. The next moment, the man turned into a black ball of light and flew towards the ninth pillar.
"I hope it won't affect you too much"
Zhou Qi murmured something to himself and then looked at the zenith. There is a palace above the nine pillars, but no one can see it. This is a palace that no one knows except the Nine Lords.
"The time for the four generations of Lord Wuke to co-respect the Palace was the shortest. The Ancient Era collapsed in the First Palace of Fa Zi Dao. Now it is still the time era of the Immortal Zi Palace. There is still a chance."
After Zhou Qi finished speaking, he carved a paragraph on the seventh pillar behind him and disappeared.
Jianmu Daojie, Muzhitian Daojie, is the thirteenth Taoist world in Zhongtian Daojie, a branch of the "Xianzi Dao First Palace" of the central Taoist court.
Zhou Qi looked at the Taoist world in front of him without making any move for a long time.
"There is no way to understand Mu Xin's aura. It seems to be a little early. I wish I didn't miss it."
Zhou Qi frowned and then relaxed, then stepped towards the Jianmu Realm, but there was no obstruction from the Dao Realm.
Jianmu Dao World is a world of cultivation full of life. There are no fights, no sects, and no rulers in this world. It is different from the thousands of Taoisms in other worlds. Everyone here only cultivates the rules of wood and the artistic conception of life.
Here is an endless green ocean. The entire continent is full of vitality, and there is only one giant tree in the center.
I saw that the root system of the tree extends for countless millions of miles. The main texture is composed of flowing stars, and each leaf on the canopy is a collapsing micro-universe.
When you get close to the tree trunk within a hundred feet, you will see the Dao fruit crystals of those who have failed in the tribulation of the past hanging among the branches - in those translucent ambers, there are dragons and phoenixes struggling eternally, and monks repeating their battles.
At this moment, a figure appeared in front of Jianmu, it was Zhou Qi
"Qingzu"
Zhou Qi faced Jianmu and said two words, then kept staring and said nothing. Just when there was no response, when he was about to raise his hand, an old voice came from Jianmu.
"I said, boy, I just met you just now, why are you here again?" Zhou Qi's expression changed when he heard this.
"This is my first time here"
"It seems like the sixth time."
"Sure enough, something went wrong. Do you still remember what I asked?"
"Every time you come here, you ask me how many times I am here. The first time you asked me, my ancestor, you asked me the same question. I can't understand you juniors anymore."
If I didn't feel that you were a bit dangerous, my ancestor would not pay attention to you. Jianmu could only curse in his heart for the last part of his sentence.
Zhou Qi looked at Jianmu without saying anything, and then disappeared. Just when Jianmu breathed a sigh of relief, Zhou Qi appeared again.
"This is my first time here"
Jianmu was stunned for a moment, as if he didn't react.
